title: 第655章 杀我还想我救你不要脸第654章 借刀杀人
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
众人不容多说，一百多名古族强者齐齐动身，铺天盖地朝着巫翎、雷霸天一行人席卷而去。
霎时间整片空域大战爆发，各族独门神通齐齐绽放，场面惊心动魄。
二十多名巫族、雷族强者被上百各族高手团团围困，根本没有半点还手的余地。
巫翎不断催动巫术，抵挡四面八方的攻势，慌忙嘶吼辩解：“诸位住手，我们不是玄冥余孽，全是误会，天大的误会啊！”
可众人早已恨透了玄冥邪祟，哪里听得进去半分解释，出手一招比一招狠辣。
一道岩族山岳狠狠落在巫翎胸口，只听咔嚓几声脆响，数根肋骨当场断裂。
她整个人倒飞出去，半边脸颊青肿流血，狼狈不堪。
另一边的雷霸天处境同样凄惨。
他一身雷道威力强横，可架不住数十名各族强者轮番围攻，不过百招，他身上布满深浅不一的伤口。
他暴怒嘶吼着：“住手，都住手，区区一点矛盾，你们非要逼得巫族、雷族和所有古族开战吗？”
这话反倒激起所有人更大的怒火。
一名丹族长老厉声大喝：“当年玄冥浩劫害得各族传承险些断绝，今日你们行玄冥邪祟之举，还敢在此大放厥词，往死里打！”
各族强者不再留手，看家绝学尽数铺开。
金木风火土、符文、灵药、罡风、山岳之力交织碰撞，整片虚空剧烈震颤，轰鸣巨响连绵不绝。
雷光、黑雾、丹火、藤蔓、巨石漫天飞舞，彻底将巫雷两族追兵死死碾压在包围圈中。
整片长空厮杀不休，各族神通一层叠一层压向巫族、雷族众人，没有半分留情。
巫翎身上横七竖八布满伤口，肋骨断裂数根，半边身子肿得青紫，周身护体巫气早已稀薄到近乎消散。
眼看再撑片刻，就要被无数神通碾得肉身崩碎。
巫翎心中再也撑不住，顾不得族长颜面，拼尽全力扯开嗓子，朝着包围圈外的云星落凄厉呼救。
“云星落，救救我们，求你救救我们！”

她一边硬扛四面八方袭来的攻势，一边急声大喊，眼底满是惶恐，“你手握鸿蒙天机盘，此宝能勘破本源，分辨神魂，一眼就能看清我们是不是玄冥余孽夺舍转生。”
“云星落，求你开口阻拦众人，饶我两族上下一命！”
云星落静静站在神符族人群后方，身旁夜葬、叶凌霜、霍小棠悬浮在侧。
她眼神淡漠，声音冰冷：“刚才你们还要杀我们夺宝，我为什么要救你们？”
巫翎被风族数道风刃割破肩头，一口鲜血喷出，慌忙咬牙许诺：“只要你肯开口为我们澄清误会，我巫族在此立誓，从今往后，再也不会惦记鸿蒙天机盘，绝不找你们报复。”
一旁苦苦支撑的雷霸天同样浑身浴血，胸口、后背全是深浅伤口。
content_en:
There was no room for anyone to say anything, and more than a hundred strong men from the ancient clan set out in unison, sweeping towards Wu Ling, Lei Batian and his group.
In an instant, a war broke out in the entire airspace, and the unique magical powers of each tribe blossomed, and the scene was thrilling.
More than twenty strong men from the Witch Clan and Thunder Clan were surrounded by hundreds of masters from all races, leaving no room for them to fight back.
Wu Ling continued to use his witchcraft to resist the attacks from all directions, and hurriedly yelled and defended: "Everyone, stop it, we are not the remnants of Xuanming, it is all a misunderstanding, a huge misunderstanding!"
But everyone had already hated Xuan Ming Xie Sui so much that they couldn't even hear half of his explanation, and every move he made was more cruel than the last.
A rock tribe mountain fell hard on Wu Ling's chest. There were only a few crunching sounds, and several ribs were broken on the spot.
She flew backwards, half of her cheeks were bruised and bleeding, and she was in a miserable state.
Lei Batian's situation on the other side was equally miserable.
His thunderbolt was so powerful that he could not withstand dozens of strong men from all races who took turns attacking him. With only a hundred moves, his body was covered with wounds of varying depths.
He roared angrily: "Stop it, stop it, everyone, do you have to force the Witch Clan, Thunder Clan, and all the ancient tribes to go to war over just a little contradiction?"
These words only aroused everyone's anger.
An elder of the Dan clan shouted sternly: "Back then, the Xuanming catastrophe nearly cut off the inheritance of all clans. Today, you have done Xuanming's evil deeds, and you dare to speak nonsense here and fight to death!"
The strong men of all races no longer held back their hands, and spread all their special skills.
The power of metal, wood, wind, fire, earth, runes, elixirs, wind, and mountains intertwined and collided, causing the entire void to tremble violently, with continuous roars and loud noises.
Thunder light, black mist, pill fire, vines, and boulders were flying all over the sky, completely crushing the pursuers of the Wu and Lei clan into the encirclement.
The whole sky is filled with endless fighting, and the magical powers of each tribe are pressing down on the people of the Witch and Thunder tribes one after another, showing no mercy.
Wu Ling's body was covered with wounds, several ribs were broken, half of his body was swollen and bruised, and the protective witch energy around him had become so thin that it had almost dissipated.
Seeing that if he could hold on for just a moment longer, his body would be crushed to pieces by countless magical powers.
Wu Ling couldn't hold it in anymore, and regardless of the clan leader's face, he tried his best to scream for help towards Yun Xingluo outside the encirclement.
"Yunxingluo, save us, please save us!"
While resisting the attacks coming from all directions, she shouted urgently, her eyes full of panic, "You hold the Hongmeng Heavenly Secret Disk in your hand. This treasure can detect the origin, distinguish the soul, and you can see clearly at a glance whether we are the remnants of the Xuan Ming who have reincarnated."
"Yun Xingluo, please speak up and stop everyone, and spare the lives of my two clans!"
Yun Xingluo stood quietly behind the Shenfu clan crowd, with Ye Zang, Ye Lingshuang, and Huo Xiaotang floating beside him.
Her eyes were indifferent and her voice was cold: "You were trying to kill us just now to get the treasure. Why should I save you?"
Wu Ling's shoulder was cut by several wind blades from the Wind Clan, and a mouthful of blood spurted out. He hurriedly gritted his teeth and promised: "As long as you are willing to open your mouth to clarify the misunderstanding for us, our Wu Clan hereby swears that from now on, we will never miss the Hongmeng Tianji Pan again, and we will never seek revenge from you."
Lei Batian, who was struggling to support himself, was also covered in blood, with deep and shallow wounds on his chest and back.
